name: Keo cu do
summary: Kẹo cu đơ is a sweet the provincial tourism portal names at Chợ Đồng Hới, with bánh xèo, cháo canh, and bánh canh. The portal does not say what the sweet is made of.
origin: Named at Chợ Đồng Hới by the provincial tourism portal. A recipe was not printed.
howToEat: Buy it with the market stalls, in the early morning or the afternoon, which is when the portal says most counters sell.
What is in the sweet was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. Hours are Check on arrival.
where: Chợ Đồng Hới, on Mẹ Suốt.
